policy.resolver: Use atlasIds and regionAliases as authored; historicalNames are display metadata, not aliases for the resolver. For changan reuse canonical pilot ID. All site anchors represent dataset points, not archaeological certainty.
policy.province: Use existing multi-region map context, no representative site or centroid pin.
policy.grouping: Identical region anchors group visual markers, preserve distinct event texts; do not invent offsets.
policy.route: Use existing resolveJourney: omit equal-point segments, break across unresolved stops, default off; dashed approximate event connections, not actual travel path.
policy.incidental: Other incidental toponyms not in this 45-record scope remain source-labelled text, not silently asserted coordinates.

atlas.yearNote: Normalized absolute CE years from research event rows; use positive runtime years. Context participants are not pins.
